scope: Independent read-only review of saved GM-R4 UI repairs, tests and 32 preview screenshot mappings. Product sources were not changed, browser was not operated and tests were not rerun by this audit.

findings.problem: Modal Tab containment skipped protected Shadow-root controls and retained hidden/inert candidates.
findings.repair: Traverse composed Shadow/slot order, resolve deep active control, filter invisible/disabled/inert candidates and recover outside focus.
findings.limit: Stub DOM tests establish algorithm branches; preview browser input independently establishes nested-proxy Tab order.

findings.problem: Theme focus restoration could replace new modal initial focus and lose the settings opener after presentation replacement.
findings.repair: Keep visible new-modal initial focus and use the new semantic settings opener when the original trigger is gone.
findings.limit: Preview records both theme directions and Escape return. Installed final-source results belong to the parent GM record.

findings.problem: An unconditional empty account-settings slot advertised an unavailable account section in GM.
findings.repair: Forward the account-settings slot only when injected by the runtime.
findings.limit: The real-root composition test exercises absent/injected account capabilities, unique controller/audio and a stable protected overlay; it does not establish native account transport.

findings.problem: Studio required navigation entries appeared hideable.
findings.repair: Label required entries, disable their checkbox and guard hide intents while keeping optional entries editable.

findings.problem: Library enqueue-only actions advertised removal of existing queue membership.
findings.repair: Use explicit add mode in library tables; existing members display a disabled already-queued action. Retain catalog toggle behavior.

findings.problem: Studio platform-order rows ran together visually.
findings.repair: Add scoped ordered-list/row spacing while retaining ol/li and explicit up/down buttons.

findings.problem: Plugin toggle labels had about 17.7 CSS px hit height.
findings.repair: Use 44 CSS px minimum label rows in both themes.
findings.limit: Measured label geometry proves browser CSS hit area, not physical-touch execution.

findings.problem: Material search lacked an accessible name; remounting an unchanged empty collection cleared its unfinished query.
findings.repair: Name the material search input and return early for stable collection identity, retaining explicit switch/file resets.
findings.limit: Retained draft/title/query/collection text is evidence for presentation continuity, not publishing or native saving.

findings.problem: Rejecting last-source disablement could leave Studio native checkbox unchecked without feedback.
findings.repair: Keep the last enabled source checked/disabled with an associated status explanation and restore rejected native change state to the authoritative projection.
findings.limit: Three component cases cover last-source protection, enabling a second source and disabling among multiple sources. This preview record does not claim a live last-source test.

validationBoundary.automated: Use the final combined-workspace test/typecheck/lint/format/build evidence in ../gm-r3/ and ../../T13-gm-r3.json; this audit does not replace those recorded executions.
validationBoundary.preview: Preview browser inputs/observations are independent of installed GM. See preview-coverage.json.
validationBoundary.installed: The parent GM-R4 acceptance record owns final installed-production checks.
validationBoundary.native: No new Tauri/native, physical keyboard/mouse or touch-hardware acceptance is implied.

evidenceCorrection.method: Pillow opens/verifies the original bytes and reports actual format/dimensions; SHA-256 recomputed. Visible page headings independently reviewed from original screenshot contact sheets.
evidenceCorrection.filenameLimit: All 32 recorded .png files contain JPEG bytes returned by the preview browser screenshot API. Filenames and bytes remain unchanged; imageFormat/imageWidth/imageHeight replace invalid PNG-header-derived dimensions.
evidenceCorrection.pageMapping: The 32 page/theme mappings match their visible headings. Studio narrow numeric names follow reviewed rendered pages, not the earlier AX destination; preview-narrow-studio-1.png remains excluded as a duplicate catalog frame.
evidenceCorrection.reviewScope: No clear clipping/overlap found at contact-sheet inspection scale. This review does not establish contrast ratios, all scroll positions, fine typography or a complete page/color/viewport Cartesian matrix.
evidenceCorrection.residualSamplingLimit: Some Classic narrow screenshots retain the prior playlist bottom-navigation highlight during transition; this sample alone does not establish a persistent current-code navigation defect.
